affinity.notes: The long inscribed bands read as physical ritual implements rather than elemental body construction.

anatomy.notes: Wrapped humanoid body and gesturing arms remain clear beneath the hanging bands.

archetype.notes: Ritual support caster communicates the processional glyph-scribe duty.

counterplay.notes: Extended bands and deliberate hand gestures visibly signal a ritual windup and its likely lanes of influence.

finish.notes: Strong textile, gold, and parchment differentiation.

framing.notes: Full-body presentation cleanly accommodates the long ritual strips.

identity.notes: Mummified funerary scribe identifies the Sacred Servant form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
